body:
Implemented the shared motion system in application commit ad250d0: bounded content cascades, continuous navigation selection, native dialog/menu entrances and exits, and consistent button, card and saved-state feedback. Live reduced-motion changes settle active effects. Existing components and the concurrent Focus/Calendar/Timeline corrections are preserved.

The full gate passes 466 tests. Broad HTTPS/planning workflows, all 28 Chromium suites and eleven selected WebKit suites pass, including corrected native-exit fixture reruns. Inspected light/dark, desktop/mobile, keyboard, emulated touch, interrupted navigation and reduced-motion behavior.

The original manual application was rebuilt and restarted at https://100.122.250.14:47832. Trusted HTTPS serves all 32 expected assets; 75 prior source versions, three pins, preferences, certificate, instance and command epoch are unchanged. Unrelated owner card edits remain separate.

Evidence: progress/2026-10-01-motion-system.md. No card status, priority, focus or acceptance was changed by this report. Physical-device, frame-rate and full release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Shared motion verified and available in the existing application
